correctness.rationale: For every m>=3, Kemeny=tr(L+J/N)^(-1)-1 has positive-definite Hessian along every nonzero edge-weight direction, hence unique global optimum and exact automorphism reduction. The Kirchhoff-index bridge decomposition gives A/a1+C/a2+D/a3+B/b. Stochasticity forces b=(1-a1)/2, a3=1-a2 and leaves one coupling inequality. Its unique minimizer is on the x+y=1 face for m<=8, and in the interior for m>=9 because H(m)=12(AC-2BD)=-8m^3+74m^2-82m+25 has H(8)=9>0, H(9)=-551<0 and is decreasing for m>=8. The symbolic exact arithmetic and independent spectral trace test at m=3,4,5,9 verify nonstandard identities and finite instances; no finite computation is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: This natural first nontrivial pendant depth yields an all-size exact Kemeny design with a sharp integer holding-probability phase transition. Smaller pendant depths force all nonterminal vertex stochasticity constraints to saturate; length three produces the first release of such a constraint. The all-asymmetric global uniqueness and explicit exact objective value make a reproducible benchmark for Markov design, without asserting a general theorem for arbitrary graph topologies or a large engineering gain.
